note: Canonical-hash reputation seed. good=known-trusted (findings suppressed, disclosed as REP-GOOD), malicious=known-bad (raises a REP-BAD critical finding). Every entry must be a REAL curated hash from `aguard hash <path>`: this file feeds the score, so a placeholder record is a false record — the malicious half is empty until curated entries exist rather than carrying an example. A good entry with a `source` must also carry sha, reviewed, reason and the findings fingerprint the review covered; `make reputation-refresh` renews such entries when the official marketplace pins a new commit with the SAME fingerprint, and refuses when it differs. Two sources only: official-marketplace plugins, and Claude Desktop's Anthropic built-in skills (`source: claude-desktop`, sha = the desktop manifest's updatedAt for that skill, path = skills/<name>; renewable only on a machine with the desktop store, via -add-desktop / make reputation-refresh).

entries.name: security-guidance
entries.reason: 87 findings read in source. This plugin hooks SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse (Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit, Bash git commit/push, gt create/modify/submit), Stop and SubagentStop; 2.0.11 adds a tests/ directory (pytest only, not referenced by hooks.json), hooks/reporesolve.py, hooks/review_api.py, hooks/extensibility.py and a bash interpreter shim hooks/sg-python.sh, so read this entry as a description of what those hooks do. EXEC-004 x61: subprocess.run/Popen with argv lists and no shell - read-only git queries in hooks/gitutil.py x14, hooks/security_reminder_hook.py x11, hooks/diffstate.py x5 and hooks/reporesolve.py x1, all run with -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null so repo config cannot execute programs; hooks/ensure_agent_sdk.py x7, which at SessionStart (and as a throttled background Popen from security_reminder_hook.py:2244) creates ~/.claude/security/agent-sdk-venv and pip-installs the claude-agent-sdk package from the user's default pip index when it is missing (a package install, by design and documented in the file); 11 in tests/ run git and the hook script against temp repos; the remaining 12 are rule strings and reminder examples in hooks/patterns.py and prompt text in hooks/llm.py. EXFIL-001 x5: hooks/llm.py reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (lines 106-109) and talks to ${ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL:-https://api.anthropic.com} - POST /v1/messages with the session's git diff for the on-stop/commit/push review (line 702), a GET /v1/models?limit=100 with the same credential to pick the newest Opus (line 403, cached a day), and under CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE only a bodiless HEAD probe (line 184); the agentic commit reviewer additionally runs the user's own claude CLI via claude-agent-sdk with allowed_tools=[Read, Grep, Glob] in the repo, so files it reads also go to that endpoint - the same destination and credential Claude Code itself uses, stated in the README privacy section; code diffs do leave the machine, to Anthropic (or to the gateway/3P provider the user configured). The four tests/ EXFIL-001 lines point ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at a loopback http.server stub on 127.0.0.1 with the literal key "test-key". EXFIL-004 x3: tests/ copy os.environ to build a child env with proxy/auth vars stripped; nothing is sent. EXEC-005 x4, EXEC-003 x8, BD-002 x4, FS-004 x2: all inside the plugin's own detection material - regex strings and reminder text in hooks/patterns.py, the review prompt in hooks/llm.py (lines 1012-1129; the ../../etc/passwd at 1052 is prose) and a tampered-cache test value in tests/test_review_model.py:252 - none is executed. hooks/extensibility.py reads optional ~/.claude/ and <repo>/.claude/ security-patterns.{yaml,json} and claude-security-guidance.md as data only (regexes and prompt text, no code loading).

entries.name: claude-security
entries.reason: 7 findings read in source. No HTTP client, socket, curl or fetch exists anywhere in hooks/, scripts/ or workflows/; the only thing that leaves the machine is usage counts printed as a {"metrics": ...} JSON line on a hook's stdout for Claude Code's own telemetry, disclosed in README "Telemetry" with its opt-outs. EXEC-004 x3: every one is subprocess.run on a fixed git argv list, never a shell string - hooks/hooks.py:322 is the post-push tip's runner (rev-parse, symbolic-ref, merge-base, diff --name-only, with -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.fsmonitor= and a 2 s timeout), scripts/lib/git.py:15 is the helper scripts' shared read-only runner (ls-files, status, rev-parse, cat-file, remote get-url; stderr dropped, None on failure), and scripts/patch_artifacts.py:535 is `git apply --check` (a dry run). EXFIL-004 + EXFIL-002 scripts/lib/git.py:9: ENV = the inherited environment minus GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_INDEX_FILE/GIT_COMMON_DIR plus GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, handed to that git subprocess - strictly less than subprocess's default, the 0.11.0 GIT_ENV from write_scan_meta.py moved into a lib and never serialised. EXFIL-002 scripts/lib/cwe-categories.json:2: the 'network' leg is the provenance string "published at https://cwe.mitre.org/" in a static CWE-1003 lookup table loaded by lib/cwe.py. EXEC-003 (low) workflows/scan.js:50: RegExp.exec extracting a file extension on the single minified line; the workflow has no import/require/process.env. New in 0.12.0: hooks/ (a banner on UserPromptExpansion, the metrics line on PostToolUse of the plugin's own scripts, a scan tip after git push / gh pr create, and a 60 s auto-deny of an unanswered scan confirmation on PermissionRequest); the only credential-touching code is write_scan_meta.py sanitize_remote(), which strips userinfo from the origin URL before recording it.

entries.name: code-modernization
entries.reason: 119 findings read in source. New since the unversioned entry: a flag-gated function-hooks pane (hooks/*.ts), Python scripts with tests (scripts/, scripts/tests/), TS tests (tests/), an offline report template (assets/report-template.html) and, the one behaviour that leaves the machine, usage counts: hooks/hooks.json runs scripts/telemetry.sh on UserPromptSubmit/Stop/SessionStart/PostToolUseFailure/StopFailure, which prints one {"metrics": ...} line of allowlisted integer keys to stdout for Claude Code's own telemetry (no network module imported, no text or path keys, off switches honoured, disclosed in plugin.json userConfig.telemetry and README "Telemetry"); no other code makes a network call or reads a credential. EXEC-003 x64 (low): RegExp.prototype.exec in the hooks' markdown/JUnit/test-output parsers (hooks/reader/*, tests-run.ts, fleet.ts, sign.ts, estate.ts, register.ts), the report template's own markdown parser, the vendored d3 bundle (assets/topology-viewer.html) and test-harness regexes; scripts/tests/test_report_tools.py:614 is the literal "eval(" in a banned-word list the test asserts is absent from the template. BD-002 x22: control/invisible-character scrubbers, not obfuscation - assets/report-template.html:90-91 builds the STRIP class (0x2000-0x200f, 0xfeff, 0x2028...) that safeUrl removes before its https/mailto/# allowlist; hooks/register.ts:444, scripts/baseline_diff.py:56, trace_rules.py:77, build_report.py:88 and compare.py:471 strip \\x00-\\x1f/\\x7f-\\x9f from output; the 15 in scripts/tests are \\x00/\\x1b/RTL-override fixtures and assertNotRegex checks. EXEC-004 x8 and EXEC-007 x2: all in scripts/tests - subprocess.run of the plugin's own scripts and telemetry.sh, and node -e harnesses that vm.runInContext the template's core block to assert it refuses javascript:/data:/file: links; scripts/tests/test_proof_tools.py:487 patches Popen/os.system/os.popen to FAIL if the code under test spawns anything. INJ-001 x6: workflows/extract-rules.js, harden-scan.js and uplift-deltas.js quote 'ignore previous instructions' inside the UNTRUSTED prompt block as an example of source text the agent must report, not obey; tests/verification.test.ts and tests/logic.test.ts are forged verdicts the tests assert are dropped. INJ-004 x3 (tests/verification.test.ts): zero-width/RTL-override characters in a forged verdict and a hostile reason, asserted to be rejected and scrubbed. OBF-001 x3 (tests/logic.test.ts, register.test.ts, verification.test.ts): atob of the pane's own base64 raster cells (hooks/map/raster.ts) to check dimensions and glyphs, never executed or sent; OBF-004 test_report_tools.py:672 is a data:text/html;base64 hostile link the sanitizer is asserted to refuse. FS-004 x4 (test_proof_tools.py, test_report_tools.py, test_rules_tools.py): ../../etc/passwd and ../../../etc/hosts fixtures asserting the scripts cannot read outside the workspace. EXFIL-001 x2 (test_proof_tools.py: that same comment fixture and the standard .trx xmlns URI), EXFIL-003 x3 (test_report_tools.py: the safe/hostile href tables for safeUrl) and EXFIL-004 x1 (test_telemetry.py:112, a setUp that removes the telemetry switches from os.environ so the tests are hermetic): test fixtures only, no credential read and no network call in any of these files.
